article.description: Pune property registration: Aadhaar verification mandatory from Oct 1; if fingerprint fails, iris scan or Aadhaar app face authentication to prevent fraud, ease seniors.
article.articleTextExcerpt: Technology 2 min read Iris scan, Aadhaar app if fingerprint fails during property registration in Maharashtra Beginning October 1, it will be essential to use Aadhaar-based identity verification for property registrations covering a wide array of documents. To assist senior citizens and those with fingerprints that cannot be read, options like iris scanning and an Aadhaar application will be available. This new approach is designed to combat fraudulent registrations while decreasing the need for witnesses during transactions. Nisha Nambiar TNN Published On Oct 3, 2026 at 08:49 AM IST Representative AI imagePUNE: People, especially senior citizens, whose fingerprints cannot be authenticated during property registration will have other options, including iris scanning and an Aadhaar app-based facility, the state registration department said.Aadhaar-based identity verification is being made compulsory for property registration from Oct 1 to check fraudulent transactions and impersonation.Aadhaar authentication will be required for 63 categories of documents, including sale, purchase, mortgage and partition deeds.
